# Rowan Ramamurthy

> Robotics engineer who builds software that lets robots share work: multi-arm task allocation, drones and the tools that tie them to real machines. The site at https://rowanr.dev/ is a 3D island you drive an AMR around; every word of it is also plain HTML on that one page.

## Timeline

- 2017 to 2021, UNSW Sydney: Bachelor of Engineering (Mechatronics, Honours Class I) and Bachelor of Science (Computer Science).
- 2019 to 2020, BLUEsat UNSW: autonomy and lidar SLAM for a student Mars rover.
- 2019 to 2021, Emesent: perception gimbal payload and simulation for the DARPA Subterranean Challenge.
- 2021, honours thesis: autonomous exploration that steers a drone toward the features that matter ([code](https://github.com/RowanRama/3D_classification)).
- 2022 to 2024, Cirrus Real Time Processing Systems, Sydney: Navy and Air Force training simulators in C++ and C#, including an electromagnetic propagation model for atmospheric ducting.
- 2024 to 2026, Georgia Tech: Master of Science in Robotics, and graduate teaching assistant.
- 2025, HANDS: hierarchical reinforcement learning for tendon-driven soft fingers ([code](https://github.com/RowanRama/HANDS)).
- 2025 to 2026, AMPF, Georgia Tech: multi-agent task allocation that splits one toolpath between several robot arms without collisions ([pyrobopath fork](https://github.com/RowanRama/pyrobopath/tree/dev), [PairwiseCollisionNet](https://github.com/RowanRama/PairwiseCollisionNet)).

## Projects

- [ciplink](https://github.com/RowanRama/ciplink): read and write Allen-Bradley PLC tags over EtherNet/IP from Rust, Python, C, C++ and C#.
- [img2gcode](https://github.com/RowanRama/img2gcode): images, SVGs and text into plotter toolpaths, with a desktop GUI.
